title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
description: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.

items.title: 30 Years of Automated GUI Testing: A Bibliometric Analysis
items.content_text: A bibliometric review traces automated GUI testing research from 1990 to 2020, examining publication growth, citation patterns, collaboration, and emerging mobile testing topics.
items.summary: A bibliometric review traces automated GUI testing research from 1990 to 2020, examining publication growth, citation patterns, collaboration, and emerging mobile testing topics.

items.title: AgentBreaker: Evaluating Context-Aware Indirect Prompt Injection Risks in Modern Web Agents
items.content_text: AgentBreaker generates page-specific prompt injections in HTML elements to test web agents, then evaluates attacks and defenses on 60 webpages from Online-Mind2Web.
items.summary: AgentBreaker generates page-specific prompt injections in HTML elements to test web agents, then evaluates attacks and defenses on 60 webpages from Online-Mind2Web.

items.title: An Efficient Training Pipeline for Reasoning Graphical User Interface Agents

items.summary: A GUI grounding pipeline filters 4.8M synthetic examples to 12K training instances and adapts a 3B vision-language model, evaluated on ScreenSpot, Multimodal-Mind2Web, and AndroidControl.

items.title: AssistEditor: Multi-Agent Collaboration for GUI Workflow Automation in Video Creation

items.summary: AssistEditor coordinates GUI agents to turn video requirements and uploaded materials into storyboards and editing actions in professional desktop software.

items.title: Automated Testing of the GUI of a Real-Life Engineering Software using Large Language Models

items.summary: GERALLT uses LLMs to explore the GUI of engineering software and produce a list of confusing or inconsistent interface areas for developers to inspect.

items.title: Automating GUI-based Software Testing with GPT-3

items.summary: A GPT-3-based GUI testing method interprets natural-language test cases, tracks current interface elements in prompts, and navigates desktop and mobile applications.

items.title: Autonomous Large Language Model Agents Enabling Intent-Driven Mobile GUI Testing

items.summary: DroidAgent uses language models and memory to set and execute GUI test goals in Android apps; an evaluation covers 15 apps from the Themis benchmark.

items.title: Do GUI Grounders Truly Understand UI Elements?
items.content_text: A desktop GUI grounding benchmark tests whether models identify the same element across varied descriptions; a diagnosis agent generates difficult instructions using model feedback.
items.summary: A desktop GUI grounding benchmark tests whether models identify the same element across varied descriptions; a diagnosis agent generates difficult instructions using model feedback.

items.title: FDC-Ground: Improving GRPO for GUI Grounding via Exponential Rewards and Fact-Aligned Pruning

items.summary: FDC-Ground trains GUI element location models with a distance-based reward and completion pruning; a 7B model is evaluated on ScreenSpot and ScreenSpot-v2.

items.title: Focus Like a Human: Efficient GUI Grounding via Coarse-to-Fine Visual Attention and Parallel Verification

items.summary: FastFocus grounds GUI targets by proposing regions from low-resolution views and checking candidates with parallel high-resolution zooms; it is evaluated on ScreenSpot-Pro.

items.summary: A survey of robotic and intelligent process automation traces the use of machine learning and AI in business workflows and identifies open research challenges.

items.title: Guardian: A Runtime Framework for LLM-Based UI Exploration

items.content_text: A GUI navigation agent that combines stepwise reasoning with history summarization; its repository provides supervised training, reinforcement learning, and evaluation instructions.

items.title: Lightpanda Browser
items.content_text: A headless browser for AI agents and automation, with released Linux and macOS binaries and interfaces for browser control and scripted tasks.
items.summary: A headless browser for AI agents and automation, with released Linux and macOS binaries and interfaces for browser control and scripted tasks.

items.title: Moli
items.content_text: A headless browser for AI agents that extracts web content and runs browser tasks through CLI, CDP, and WebDriver interfaces, with rendering performed on demand.
items.summary: A headless browser for AI agents that extracts web content and runs browser tasks through CLI, CDP, and WebDriver interfaces, with rendering performed on demand.

items.title: openadapt-ml
items.content_text: A Python research package for GUI-action models, with trajectory schemas, model adapters, fine-tuning, grounding, and a policy interface for predicting the next action.

items.title: OpenAPA
items.content_text: A computer-use agent for desktop GUI tasks that combines screenshot-based reasoning, visual grounding, planning, and action execution across applications.
items.summary: A computer-use agent for desktop GUI tasks that combines screenshot-based reasoning, visual grounding, planning, and action execution across applications.

items.title: The TinyFish Cookbook
items.content_text: A collection of sample applications and recipes for TinyFish web agents, covering page retrieval, structured search, and multi-step browser automation.

items.title: WebOperator
items.content_text: A web agent using action-aware tree search to explore tasks and backtrack, checking page reconstruction and accounting for actions that may change website state.

items.title: Avenir-UX
items.content_text: Avenir-UX runs web tasks and scores interface usability after agent actions. It combines step assessments with persona settings and produces session reports.
